requests.syntheticReason: Title generation is not the product semantics of this case; it only needs to return stably to prevent title requests from accidentally matching business fixtures.

The core verification point is that Agent schema no longer declares model, and legacy extra parameters cannot override the builtin general-purpose profile; the parent request only needs to stably trigger legacy-shaped Agent tool_use.
The child request itself is the verification evidence for this case; the response only needs to complete stably and return sub-result tokens.
The final reply is only used to verify that Agent tool_result continues to be consumed by the parent session and returns to idle.
